newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican sees Iowa coal unit back Tues.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican sees Iowa coal unit back Tues.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Co's 300 megawatt (MW) Neal 2 coal-fired unit, shut Saturday due to a boiler tube leak, is expected to return to service within the next day, the company said Monday.
"Repairs are underway. It should be back up sometime tomorrow," a company spokesman said.
The plant is near Sioux City, Iowa.
The facility's adjacent Neal 3 coal unit, with a generating capacity of 515 MW, is running at full power, the company said.
